title: Scaling Human-AI Coding Collaboration Requires a Governable Consensus Layer
abstract: arXiv:2604.17883v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vibe coding turns natural-language intent into working software, but code generation alone does not give humans and agents a shared account of what they are building. As collaboration spans participants, components, and releases, design choices must remain understandable and open to revision. We argue that scaling human and AI coding collaboration requires a governable consensus layer. Agentic Consensus organizes collaboration around a versioned project-state model linking selected intent, structural commitments, executable artifacts, and evidence. Participants can clarify intent before implementation and coordinate proposed changes against commitments that humans can inspect and revise. Bidirectional synchronization connects intended changes to implementation and exposes conflicts or stale evidence as artifacts evolve. We implemented its review workflow in Consensus Control. translated_title: 扩展人机编码协作需要一个可治理的共识层
translated_abstract: 氛围编码（Vibe coding）将自然语言意图转化为可运行的软件，但仅靠代码生成无法让人类和智能体对其正在构建的内容形成共同认知。随着协作跨越多个参与者、组件和版本发布，设计决策必须保持可理解且可修订。我们认为，扩展人类与AI的编码协作需要一个可治理的共识层。Agentic Consensus（智能体共识）围绕一个版本化的项目状态模型来组织协作，该模型将选定的意图、结构性承诺、可执行工件和证据联系在一起。参与者可以在实现之前澄清意图，并基于人类可检查、可修订的承诺来协调提议的更改。双向同步将预期变更与实现连接起来，并在工件演进过程中暴露冲突或过时的证据。我们在Consensus Control中实现了该审查工作流。在一项小规模探索性人类研究中，10名参与者……
tldr: 该论文提出扩展人机编码协作需要引入一个可治理的共识层，通过版本化的项目状态模型将意图、结构性承诺、代码工件和证据关联起来，使人类能够在AI编码过程中检查、协调和修订共享的设计决策。
